rules.title: No Cheating
rules.description: Any use of unauthorised modifications, hacks, or exploits is strictly prohibited.

rules.title: Respect Others
rules.description: Treat all players and staff with respect. Harassment, discrimination, or hate speech will not be tolerated.

rules.title: No Griefing
rules.description: Do not destroy, steal, or alter another player's builds or belongings without permission.

rules.title: No Advertising
rules.description: Advertising other servers or services is not allowed.

rules.title: Keep Chat Appropriate
rules.description: Avoid spamming, excessive swearing, or inappropriate content in chat.

rules.title: Follow Discord TOS
rules.description: All members must adhere to Discord's Terms of Service and Community Guidelines.

rules.title: No Spamming
rules.description: Avoid sending repeated messages, emojis, or links.

rules.title: Respect Privacy
rules.description: Do not share personal information of yourself or others.

rules.title: No NSFW Content
rules.description: Sharing NSFW or inappropriate content is strictly forbidden.
